$comment: First-mod tour (Q245). subjectType: the element type the tour makes. steps: id (strings tour.<id>.title and tour.<id>.text), check (element: the user made a new element of subjectType; texture: its texture is set, exists and is not the one it started with; scenario: the test scenario below passed on a dedicated server), point: CSS selectors of the UI the step points at, the first visible one is outlined. scenario: written to scenarios/<file>.json and run by the Scenarios runner; {id} is the element id and {ref} its registry name (mod id:id).
